<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Sleek Reposition](/Feats.aspx?ID=4786) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fighter" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=601" />
<trait label="Press" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=133" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 143

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) If you're wielding a polearm, you can ignore Reposition's requirement that you have a hand free_

**Requirements**
You are wielding a finesse weapon or polearm

</column>

---

While your opponent is still recovering from your prior attack, you snag its armor, clothing, or flesh to move it as you please. Make a melee Strike with a finesse weapon or polearm. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, you can automatically Reposition it, with the same benefits as the Reposition action (including the critical success effect, if your Strike was a critical hit). If you used a weapon with reach, use the weapon’s reach for this Reposition.

This Strike has the following failure effect.

**Failure** The target becomes [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) until the end of your current turn.
name: Sleek Reposition
requirement: You are wielding a finesse weapon or polearm
